title: Ban por excesos de combat logs.

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Translation:

Hello,

Well I'm banned for excessively combat logging (3). First off, I wanna say I'm sorry for what I did and I also wanted to say, that as you guys are a great community I'd love coming back and never ever break any other rule that I'm supposed to abidy by; I'm sure I'll never do it again and I really hope you take my apologies into account and my reasons in this appeal. Thanks for your time.
